text_to_image_prompt: Create one photorealistic full-length standing studio portrait of an adult woman. Warm lightly tanned complexion, hazel-green eyes, long chestnut loose waves with a center part, softly angular oval face, full muted pink lips. Complete outfit: Fitted light sand moto-inspired sleeveless short vest with subtle metal closures, coordinated mid-thigh pleated skirt and slim belt, sleek black knee-high boots without fringe, modest heels. Tall healthy fashion-model anatomy, approximately 7.5–8 anatomical heads tall, normal proportional head, balanced shoulders and hips, defined natural waist, long coherent thighs and calves, normal-sized feet. Strict frontal upright face and body, gaze directly forward, level eyes/shoulders/pelvis, arms relaxed at sides with anatomically correct empty hands, feet parallel. Entire hairstyle through both shoe soles visible with narrow margins, 94% frame height. White seamless studio with a tiny soft ground shadow, even bright neutral frontal illumination, 85mm lens perspective without distortion, deep focus. Crisp natural skin pores, clear eyes and lips, individual hair strands, fabric texture, seams and fingers. Native 1024x1536, vertical 2:3. No text, border, logo, watermark, blur or collage.
original_prompt:
Generate ONE completely NEW native high-resolution fashion character-library full-length studio photograph. Vertical 2:3, 1024 x 1536. This is a new photographic rendering, not a stretch, resize, upscale or retouch of an old full-body image.
REFERENCE PRIORITY: Image 1 is the ONLY identity authority: reproduce her individual facial geometry, eye color, hair color, hairstyle, complexion and expression faithfully. She is an adult woman. Image 2 is ONLY the approved Sunset Island female MODEL BODY / PROPORTION reference. Image 3 is ONLY the clothing reference. Do not borrow faces or hairstyles from images 2/3. Never use the old rejected body.
BODY: A tall elegant approximately 178 cm adult female fashion model with a healthy toned, graceful, shapely silhouette and 7.8 anatomical heads from skull crown to sole (head approximately 12.8% of standing height). Use image 2's small naturally proportioned head relative to well-developed shoulders, ribcage and pelvis. Balanced softly defined shoulders about 2.3 head-widths, graceful neck of normal length, shaped bust, clearly defined natural waist, smoothly rounded hips. Long naturally proportioned thighs AND calves, visible structural knees and normal ankle/foot size. Crotch around 48% down standing height, knees around 73%. Refined long-limbed model silhouette, neither a straight stocky column nor a tiny narrow torso under a huge head. Anatomical proportion must come from coherent whole-body anatomy, not simply extremely long shins, an unnaturally high trouser waistband, or high platform shoes. Maintain the face's proportions while scaling the whole head correctly to the model's body. Voluminous hair must not become a giant inflated helmet.
POSE / CAMERA: Strict straight frontal symmetrical stance, head upright with zero tilt or turn, pupils looking straight at the camera, level shoulders and pelvis, spine vertical, natural relaxed arms with a slight gap from torso, empty hands at upper-mid thighs, feet parallel naturally separated by a small gap. Fashion model presence without twisting or exaggerated posing. Undistorted 85 mm portrait-lens perspective, vertical camera and no wide-angle or foreshortening. Entire hairstyle and both soles fully in frame, figure fills approximately 94% of image height.
LIGHT / QUALITY: Pure white seamless studio, tiny soft contact shadow beneath feet. Even bright soft frontal light illuminates the entire face, matching image 1's brightness. Deep focus with clear eyes, lashes, lips, skin texture, individual hair strands, fingers, fabric seams and fabric texture. Rich natural photographic detail; no blurry face, haze, skin smearing or painterly softness. No text, watermark, collage, props, border or extra person.

IDENTITY DESCRIPTION (defer to image 1): Rich brown voluminous waves, hazel eyes, warm complexion and soft freckles. Slight variation: chestnut waves, modest sand-beige square-neck blouse with sleeves, small gold studs.
CLOTHING REPLACEMENT: Fitted light sand moto-inspired sleeveless short vest with subtle metal closures, coordinated mid-thigh pleated skirt and slim belt, sleek black knee-high boots without fringe, modest heels.
Replace the upper garment shown in image 1 with the specified complete outfit. Use the garment construction of image 3 and fit it correctly to the model proportions. Keep original face, hairstyle and recognizable hair accessories.
